description: The brand or shopping platform of the day on Instagram in Turkey: last week's creators and contents against the week before, share of the conversation against its rivals, the head-to-head with rivals (Reel plays, likes and comments, average creator quality) and who it reached (gender, age, city, two top interests). Aggregate figures only; no creator is named. Optional day (YYYY-MM-DD) returns an earlier day. No key needed.

day.description: A day, YYYY-MM-DD; the latest day when omitted

name: brand_of_the_day
title: Brand of the Day
